title: BXT-055 gravel frameset
notes: Current exact-model direct storefront lists US$599 for a no-handlebar option, in-stock status and worldwide shipping. Specifications state 1,100 g ±50 g for size 54, 410 g ±20 g fork, 110 g ±10 g seatpost, T47 threaded 86 mm shell, UDH and 50C clearance. The package contains frame, fork, cable spacer, UDH hanger, T47 bottom bracket, dust cover, thru axles, headset, matte seatpost and clamp. No mainland CNY checkout was captured. Fiber-grade claims are not independent evidence of execution quality.
